comment: The velvet quality and Zardozi embroidery on this Laddu Gopal poshak is beyond breathtaking! Fitting for Size 3 was perfect. Jai Shree Krishna!
Bought the Dhoti Kurta for my 4-year-old son for Janmashtami function. Soft cotton lining inside pure Banarasi silk made him super comfortable all day.
The peacock plume and Kundan work on the Mukut is divine! Came wrapped in a velvet storage box. Extremely fast shipping.
